name: able-0.9.4-beta
body:
Able 0.9.4 beta.

- New Network section in Tools: Speed test, Hotspot, Private DNS (now its own tool) and Downdetector.
- Speed test: ping, jitter, download and upload against Cloudflare, with a live gauge and local history.
- Downdetector: opens the outage page of a service on your country's Downdetector site, with favourites.
- Drinking fountains: map of public drinking-water points from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API), last tool in Measure & location. Public Overpass servers are sometimes overloaded: Able then says so and lets you retry.
- Apps → Background: Restricted / Optimized / Unrestricted, block background mobile data, soft stop, and reviewed apps with change detection and restore (NoMoreBackground parity).
- Home-screen double tap is less sensitive: taps on icons and page swipes no longer count.

Update from Settings → Updates (0.9.3 or later), or install this APK over any earlier beta.
